reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the cited General Provisions (p0063, p0066, p0070) contain no restrictive covenant and the survival list omits any such provision, supporting the conclusion.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding — the unchanged rendering matches the originals exactly.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are explained correctly: they are unmeasurable because no non-solicit clause exists, and absence is the outcome favourable to our party, not a deviation.

Rationale documents an adequate document-wide sweep ('solicit'/'induce' zero hits; 'hire'/'employ'/'personnel' hits contextualised as indemnity, confidentiality, independent-contractor and access-control language) and records an internal fallback position for any Vendor redraft — appropriate as retained evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
